reasoning: Group queries by step and then residue, processing starts in descending order within each residue. Extend the already-summed suffix only over the disjoint gap to the next requested start; repeated starts reuse the sum. A given step scans at most n weights and only residue classes actually queried, while large steps naturally have short tails. Packed unsigned64-bit answers preserve up to3e14 totals, and packed linked query lists plus streaming integer parsing keep memory bounded without a full n-by-sqrt(n) table.
